headline: 84 held as police officer's rented house used for drug parties in Dhaka
summary: Detectives raided a property owned by an additional DIG, where they found drugs and illegal DJ parties. The officer has been placed in the OSD pool.
details: Detectives detained 84 people, including 26 women, during a raid on a three-storey house in Police Housing-1, under Khilkhet Police Station in Dhaka.
The raid took place early Tuesday morning following intelligence that the property was being used for overnight DJ parties, drug use, and drug dealing.
The house belongs to Abdullah Al Zahir, an additional deputy inspector general (ADDIG) lapped at Police Headquarters, who had rented it out via Airbnb and the Traveller platform.
During the operation, DB officials seized cannabis, yaba, alcohol, and equipment used for consuming yaba.
Following the incident, Abdullah Al Zahir was withdrawn from the Personal Management-2 branch at Police Headquarters and placed in the officer on special duty (OSD) pool.
The ADDIG told bdnews24.com that the house courtyard was rented for events like birthday parties and Gaye Holud, and that he had strict rules against illegal activities.
Zahir questioned whether landlords should be held responsible for crimes committed by tenants without their knowledge, arguing that responsibility lies with the perpetrator.

headline: 14 killed in bus-truck collision in Natore
summary: Five traders from Shariatpur were among the deceased in a head-on crash on the Pabna-Natore highway near Bonpara.
details: A head-on collision between a passenger bus and a sand-laden truck killed 14 people and left at least 30 others injured near the Bonpara roundabout on the Pabna-Natore highway.
Among the dead were five traders from Kazirhat Bazar in Shariatpur's Zajira upazila: Jewel Madbar (40), Salal Mollya (46), Sohag Shikdar (30), Samad Fakir (70), and Shahin Bepari (32).
The traders were traveling to Rajshahi to purchase agricultural produce and seeds, such as maize, onion, and garlic, for sale in their local market ahead of the Rabi season.
The group had departed from the Naodoba roundabout near the Padma Bridge South Plaza the previous evening, traveling through Faridpur before boarding a bus to Rajshahi.
The crash occurred around 4:10 am today, shortly before the bus reached its destination. Two other traders from the same group, Alamgir Madbar and Faisal, survived the accident.
Local administration and the Zajira Upazila Nirbahi Officer have pledged assistance to the families of the deceased. The bodies are being transported back to Shariatpur for a joint funeral prayer.
